proof:
Source. Step 1 and the first half of step 3 of the supplied proof of the selected node (coordinates of the centres; nearby carrier points lie on the graph and have bounded offsets), Simon 7.5.5 (chapter-07.txt lines 790–901). Departure: |p_i − x| is bounded by |C₀|λ_i + |x_i − x|, so the sign of C₀ needs no separate treatment.

1. (Pythagoras.) For a ∈ ℝ^m and b ∈ ℝ^k, |ιa + ι'b|² = |ιa|² + 2⟨ιa, ι'b⟩ + |ι'b|² = |a|² + |b|² (norm_add_sq_real, orthogonality, and LinearIsometry.norm_map). Hence |a| ≤ |ιa + ι'b| and |b| ≤ |ιa + ι'b|.
2. (Coordinates of the centres.) For each i choose s_i, t_i with x_i − x = ιs_i + ι't_i (spanning hypothesis applied to x_i − x). Then x_i = x + ιs_i + ι't_i. By step 1, |s_i| ≤ |x_i − x| and |t_i| ≤ |x_i − x|, and |x_i − x| → 0, so s_i → 0 and t_i → 0 by the squeeze theorem (squeeze_zero_norm).
3. (Nearby carrier points converge to x.) For each i choose p_i ∈ N with |p_i − x_i| ≤ C₀λ_i. Since λ_i > 0, C₀λ_i ≤ |C₀|λ_i. Hence |p_i − x| ≤ |p_i − x_i| + |x_i − x| ≤ |C₀|λ_i + |x_i − x| → |C₀|·0 + 0 = 0. So |p_i − x| < min(δ₁, δ₂) for all sufficiently large i.
4. (p_i lies on the graph.) Fix such an i. Choose a, b with p_i − x = ιa + ι'b. By step 1, |a| ≤ |p_i − x| < δ₁ and |b| ≤ |p_i − x| < δ₂. Hence p_i = x + ιa + ι'b ∈ {x + ιv + ι'w : |v| < δ₁, |w| < δ₂}, and p_i ∈ N. By the chart identity there is v with |v| < δ₁ and p_i = x + ιv + ι'u(v).
5. (The offset w.) Put w := λ_i^{−1}(v − s_i). Then s_i + λ_iw = v ∈ ball(0, δ₁). By step 2 and linearity, p_i − x_i = (x + ιv + ι'u(v)) − (x + ιs_i + ι't_i) = ι(v − s_i) + ι'(u(v) − t_i). By step 1, |v − s_i| ≤ |p_i − x_i| ≤ C₀λ_i and |u(v) − t_i| ≤ |p_i − x_i| ≤ C₀λ_i. Therefore |w| = λ_i^{−1}|v − s_i| ≤ C₀, and |u(s_i + λ_iw) − t_i| = |u(v) − t_i| ≤ C₀λ_i.
Steps 2–5 give the sequences s and t and, for every sufficiently large i, the required w. ∎

Formalization notes (this exact frozen type was proved in a scratch build with standard axioms only). Use choose s t hst using fun i => hspan (xs i − x) and choose p hpN hpd using the offset hypothesis. Then use tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero, squeeze_zero_norm and squeeze_zero, (tendsto_order.1 _).2 for the eventual bound, map_sub with abel for step 5, and pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ or nlinarith for step 1.
